products.name: Salinity Monitoring System
products.description: Specially designed for distillation plant operation on board ships. Senses the salinity content present in water in PPT (Parts Per Trillion) for high-precision measurement.
products.sub_note: The SMEC-designed distillation plant dumping valve control system is powered by this advanced salinity indicator.
features: Main control panel with salinity indicator
Controls the operation of the dumping valve as per set point
Alarm indication for high salinity presence

products.name: Generator Controllers
products.description: Provide comprehensive generator protection and control for single or multiple gen-sets based on field-proven technologies. Primary function is to manage and protect the generator (as distinct from the engine).
use_cases: Applications where engine management or protection is not required
Cases where the generator is powered by another source, such as a turbine controlled by an external PLC
products.applicability: Suitable for use in both Land-Based and Marine applications.

products.name: Engine Order Telegraph Systems
products.description: Main engine control system behavior is first carefully observed to locate a problem, then the fault is identified and rectified. System consists of electro-mechanical and digital controls for start, stop, speed control, shut down, slow-down, safety, and alarm systems -- repaired and tested as part of SMEC's service offering.
features: Two wire communication from bridge device to ER (Engine Room) device

products.name: Battery Charger (24V DC Marine/Industrial)
products.description: Specifically designed for marine environments to support emergency power requirements and general control supply needs. Full-automatic, high-efficiency battery charger/rectifier. Can also be used as a rectifier to provide rated supply directly to connected consumers. Secured against short circuit, overload, and high temperatures.
